title: Day 28 — Context-Window Token-Budget Trimmer
prompt: Our chat requests keep blowing the model's context limit as conversations grow. We need to trim the message history to a token budget. What do you keep and what do you drop?

clarifications.answer: Always keep the system message(s) — they carry the instructions and are non-negotiable.
Keep the most RECENT turns; drop from the OLDEST until it fits.
Token counting is injected as count_tokens(content). Sum it over the messages you keep (system included).
If the system message alone exceeds the budget, return just the system message — don't truncate it silently.
Preserve chronological order in the result.
Keep a contiguous most-recent block — once a message doesn't fit, stop; don't cherry-pick a small older one.

hints: Split system vs non-system. Reserve the system tokens first.
Walk the non-system messages newest-first, keeping while they fit the remaining budget; stop at the first that doesn't.
Reverse your kept list back to chronological order and return system + kept. If system alone is over budget, you still return system.
